newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Rubber futures closed steady in light trade on Thursday with light buying shoring up prices in the market, dealers said.
"It was quiet although there was some light buying for TSR20 rubber. The market was subdued because prices in Japan finished almost unchanged," a local rubber trader said.
Prices of Tokyo's benchmark April contract finished unchanged at 140.9 while Kobe's April contract settled at 140.5 yen from yesterday's close of 140.0.
"There was also some buying for RSS3 rubber by some traders," another dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, December RSS3 was seen at 124.75-126.75 U.S. cents a kg from 125.50 cents.
January RSS1 was seen at 181.50-183.50 Singapore cents (US$1.30-$1.31) a kg from the previous 182.50 cents.
January TSR20 was seen at 176.50-178.50 Singapore cents (US$1.26-$1.27) a kg from 177.50 cents.
